protective effects of sulforaphane on obesity in animal models, this molecule is capable of inhibiting the differentiation of adipo-
cytes in culture through cell cycle arrest and, in relation to diabetes, reducing the production of free radicals and the consequent
inﬂammatory damage in diabetic neuropathy and nephropathy. Therefore, further studies are needed to investigate the role of
sulfur compounds in the regulation of adipogenesis and body weight, as well as the involvement of epigenetic mechanisms in
the process.
